ui.demo.title: UI kit
ui.demo.lead: Artist Tree primitives. Compose screens from these — do not one-off restyle.
ui.demo.buttons_lead: Primary · secondary · outline · ghost · danger · outline-danger. Sizes sm / md / lg. Disabled at 45% opacity.
ui.demo.inputs_lead: Label, control slot, helper or error. Focus ring uses primary teal.
ui.demo.label: Label
ui.demo.toasts_lead: Success / error / info. Setup danger toast uses the same system.
ui.demo.toast.error_body: Check the form and try again.
ui.demo.textarea_lead: Same focus ring and invalid state as Input. Resize vertically.
ui.demo.textarea_hint: Shown on the artist advancing sheet.
ui.demo.select_lead: Styled native select. Teal focus ring; danger border when invalid.
ui.demo.controls_lead: Native checkbox and radio with teal accent. Switch is a labelled toggle.
ui.demo.badges_lead: Neutral, primary, success, warning, danger, and outline. Pill is tag-like.
ui.demo.tags_lead: Jira-style labels. Token colors or a custom hex via name + color props.
ui.demo.avatars_lead: Initials circle. Primary or neutral tone. Sizes sm / md / lg. Broken image falls back to initials.
ui.demo.tabs_lead: Underline style. Active tab uses primary teal.
ui.demo.segmented_lead: Pill in a quiet track. Selected segment uses ring, not shadow.
ui.demo.cards_lead: Quiet border, no heavy shadow. Optional header and footer slots.
ui.demo.card.title: Stage notes
ui.demo.card.body: Load-in at 14:00. Power drop stage left.
ui.demo.empty_lead: Dashed border with icon, title, description, and action slot. Page/section voids only — not inside Table.
ui.demo.empty.title: No artists yet
ui.demo.empty.description: Add an artist to start advancing hospitality and set times.
ui.demo.table_lead: Simple header and rows. Hover uses page; selected uses secondary soft.
ui.demo.icons_lead: Font Awesome Free via the Icon wrapper. Register icons in resources/js/icons.js (tree-shakeable).
setup.event.timezone_hint: Defaults to your org region. Change if the festival is elsewhere.
setup.errors.required_fields: Fill in the required fields and try again.
setup.locations.delete_body: Remove “:name” from this event. You can add it again later.
setup.artist_types.delete_body: Remove “:name” from this organization. You can add it again later.
setup.locations.delete_suggested_body: Remove “:name” from suggestions. It will not be saved on Continue.
setup.artist_types.delete_suggested_body: Remove “:name” from suggestions. It will not be saved on Continue.
events.unlock.title: Unlock this event?
events.unlock.body: Unlocking lets the office edit this event again. Day-to-day work still stays on the org active event.
events.read_only_inactive: This is not the active event. It is read-only. Day-to-day work stays on the org active event.
events.read_only_locked: This event is locked. It is read-only for history and audit.
events.lead: Open past or locked events read-only. Day-to-day work stays on the active event. Set active is parked for later.
